entities.name: Endriders
entities.description: Nomadic apocalypse punk racing team from Gastal that competed in the Ghirapur Grand Prix on Avishkar.

entities.name: Gastal
entities.description: A dying plane crossed by mounted nomads.

entities.name: Avishkar
entities.description: Plane of the Ghirapur Grand Prix.

entities.name: Far Fortune
entities.description: Leader of an Endrider gang who sought the Aetherspark.

entities.name: Aetherspark
entities.description: Prize Far Fortune wanted to bring water to Gastal.

entities.name: Omenpaths
entities.description: Paths between planes that opened after the invasion.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion after whose end the Omenpaths opened.

events.summary: After the invasion and the opening of the Omenpaths, Endrider gangs ride out of Gastal and run out of fuel.
events.quote: Endrider gangs rode their machines to freedom, leaving Gastal without a look in the rearview mirror

events.summary: Far Fortune's gang is stranded on Avishkar and enters the Ghirapur Grand Prix.
events.quote: they were stranded on Avishkar and quickly found their way into the Ghirapur Grand Prix

events.summary: Far Fortune competes in the second Grand Prix to use the Aetherspark to bring water to Gastal and control the plane.
events.quote: placing herself in control of the plane

relations.note: Her gang is among the Endriders.
relations.quote: Far Fortune 's gang was one of the crews who left Gastal
The Endriders are a racing team from Gastal
